draft.subject: Following up on our getting started call
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call on Monday — it was good to talk through how Clearwater Media wants to work in Wrenfield.

Since then I haven't seen a first project come together yet. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's the one step worth getting past. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to sit with you while you set up your first real project, so it's done rather than pending.

Best,
Nadia
